import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
di,do_=G['Demo pair 1 input'],G['Demo pair 1 output']

def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # bar: color filling a full row or column
    bar=None; orient=None; pos=None
    for j in range(w):
        if all(g[i][j]!=bg for i in range(h)): bar=j; orient='v'
    for i in range(h):
        if all(g[i][j]!=bg for j in range(w)): bar=i; orient='h'
    # shape cells: not bg and not bar color
    barcol = g[0][bar] if orient=='v' else g[bar][0]
    shape=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]!=bg and g[i][j]!=barcol]
    top=min(i for i,j in shape); bot=max(i for i,j in shape)
    left=min(j for i,j in shape); right=max(j for i,j in shape)
    new=[r[:] for r in g]
    if orient=='v':
        c = left-1 if bar>right else right+1
        for i in range(h): new[i][c]=8
    else:
        r = top-1 if bar>bot else bot+1
        for j in range(w): new[r][j]=8
    return new

print(transform(di)==do_)
